title: BPW-2026-0632
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0632
CD 11
BOS + BCA
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – PURE WATER LOS ANGELES PHASE 1A - RECYCLED WATER FOUNDATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE AT THE HYPERION WATER RECLAMATION PLANT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director of the Bureau of Sanitation to:
DISTRIBUTE and advertise the transmitted Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for the purpose of establishing a shortlist of qualified Project Developers for the design, construction, and operation of the Phase 1A - Recycled Water Foundational Infrastructure;
EVALUATE and qualify the respondents based on requirements set forth in the RFQ and develop a shortlist of qualified Project Developers for the project;
DISTRIBUTE and advertise the Request for Proposals (RFP) to the established shortlist of qualified Project Developers for the purpose of selecting a qualified developer for the design and construction of the Project;
EVALUATE the proposals and select the responsible and responsive Project Developer whose final proposal is most advantageous to the City based on established evaluation criteria set forth in RFP; and
RETURN to the Board of Public Works for authority to award and execute the contract.
(W.O.: SZH12459)
summary: Gives the Bureau of Sanitation director authority to solicit and shortlist project developers and select one to design, build and operate phase 1A of recycled water infrastructure at the Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant, with the contract award returning to the Board later.

details.action: request for authority to select project developer
